evidence.does_not_prove: Not finding anything does not show how the image was made: metadata is easily stripped, and the classifier is not reliable on every image. It is not evidence either way.
evidence.finding: Checked: exif. None found a signed provenance record, an AI label in the metadata, or a classifier score that raises a concern.
evidence.proves: Only that the checks listed here found nothing on this file.

limits: Second Look never says an image is real, genuine or authentic, or safe to trust. signed_camera means a signer's record says a camera captured it. cant_tell means we found nothing either way. A signed record does not prove that what the picture shows is true. A concern is a reason to look closer, not a verdict. Second Look is not a fact-checker and is not affiliated with Meta.
summary: Second Look can't tell how this was made, and finding nothing is not evidence either way.
